Why it works

Preparation sells homes. Hope doesn't.

The difference between an average sale and a great one is decided before the listing goes live. Ash's sellers consistently see faster sales and stronger offers because the groundwork is done right.

  • Free, no-obligation home valuation with a written comparable report
  • Professional photography, floor plans and video on every listing
  • Pre-listing inspection guidance to prevent surprises in negotiation
  • Strategic launch timing based on current market conditions
  • Weekly updates with showing feedback and market activity
  • Expert negotiation on every offer — price, conditions and closing
